summary: I ran a full frontend regression on the web preview (390x844, Expo SDK 58 / RN 0.88 / expo-router 58) after the usePreventRemove, FileHandle and absoluteFill fixes. CRITICAL guard fix verified: there is no 'Maximum update depth exceeded', no red screen and no hang anywhere. I tested browser back with Cancel then OK on projects/new, customers/new, customers/[id], reports/edit and sketches/draw. Cancel always kept the page. OK always saved or left. projects/new and reports/edit returned to the previous screen. sketches/draw saved and returned to the project, with elements persisted (1, then 2 after re-edit; header back arrow and checkmark also work). On customers/new and customers/[id], OK saves the data but the user stays on the form; see the web-only Alert issue below. Disclaimer gate, home, customer create and edit, project create (data persisted), project tabs (Info/Photos/Sketches/Measurement/Area/Roof/Checklists/Notes/Documents/Rapport), photo upload via gallery file chooser (thumbnail plus edit/move/copy/delete buttons), checklist from template (tick and save persisted) and the Rapport cost line '9,33 h × 60 €/h = 559,80 €' all work. Settings, Storage, Backup, Archive, Trash, Search, Templates, Employees, Materials and Machines all render. Web backup download (Aufmassprofi_Backup_*.json) and project export (TEST_Projekt.aufmass) work. Ionicons render correctly. MAIN WEB-ONLY ISSUE: react-native-web's Alert.alert is a no-op. Every flow that navigates or confirms only inside an Alert button callback is dead on web: post-save navigation in customers/new, customers/[id], projects/new and checklists/new, and 'Aus Datei wiederherstellen' plus snapshot restore in Backup. Native is unaffected. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none.

ui_bugs.issue: On web, tapping 'Aus Datei wiederherstellen' does nothing. handleRestoreFromFile only opens the file picker from an Alert.alert button callback, and Alert.alert is a no-op on react-native-web. handleRestoreSnapshot has the same problem. Reference: app/backup/index.tsx:106-120, 165-178

The record is saved but the screen never leaves, because router.back/replace only runs inside the Alert success callback. Tapping Save again creates a duplicate. Affected: customers/new.tsx:427 (handleNavigateBack), customers/[id].tsx:480/505, projects/new.tsx:736 (router.replace to the detail screen never happens), checklists/new.tsx:209. The same applies to the leave-guard 'OK' path on customers/new and customers/[id].

issues: The two-column rows (ZIP/City and Phone/Email) in Objektadresse overflow: the right input goes past the right screen edge.

The action row 'To Gallery' / 'Fotos auswählen' / 'Add Photo' overlaps: the To Gallery text runs under the trash icon and the subtitle is cut off ('(Löschen/Verschieben/Kopi'). In multi-select mode the 'Abbrechen' button is clipped at the right edge.
Photo card action buttons (photo-edit/move/copy) are 36x39px, below the 44px minimum.
The labels 'Line', 'Circle' and 'Rectangle' run together ('LineCircleRectangle') because each label is wider than its 38px button.

react_native_issues.issue: Dev warning: '`repeat` or `disablePrevention` from `usePreventRemove` was called, but `preventRemove` is still `true`'. It fires on every leave from projects/new and sketches/draw. It is harmless (no loop), but the warning recommends also setting preventRemove to false (for example a `leaving` state) when allowing the leave. Reference: src/hooks/useUnsavedChangesGuard.ts:33-37,89-92; app/sketches/draw.tsx:1474-1478

action_items: Optional (web-only): add a cross-platform alert helper (window.confirm/window.alert on web, Alert.alert on native) and use it in backup/index.tsx (restore from file, restore snapshot), customers/new.tsx, customers/[id].tsx, projects/new.tsx (success → router.replace(`/projects/${id}`)) and checklists/new.tsx so web flows navigate after save. photos/new already does this.
Optional: in useUnsavedChangesGuard and sketches/draw, flip the preventRemove condition to false (state flag) when allowing the leave, to silence the expo-router 58 warning.
Fix the Objektadresse two-column input overflow in projects/new and the Photos tab action-row overlap at phone width; raise photo-card action buttons to at least 44px.

Minor: Pro feature tabs only appear after app/index.tsx has run loadProStatus/updateFeatures. Deep-linking or reloading the web page on /projects/[id] hides the Pro tabs (Rapport/Documents/Measurement). Consider loading Pro status in _layout.tsx.
critical_code_review_comments: useUnsavedChangesGuard (web): when onSaveAndLeave exists, confirm 'OK' calls the save. If the save fails validation or only shows an Alert (customers), the user stays on the page with no feedback on web.
FileHandle: readBytesSync and writeBytesSync exist in expo-file-system 58.0.13 (File.types.d.ts:182/196), so the migration is valid. I could not exercise the native path on web.
No absoluteFillObject left. The sketch canvas overlays render correctly.

success_rate.frontend: ~88% (all critical flows pass; web-only Alert no-op blocks backup restore and post-save navigation)

seed_data_creation: localStorage only in the test browser: aufmassprofi_settings (disclaimer_accepted_at plus disclaimer_version '2026-06'), aufmassprofi_customers (cust1 TEST_Max Muster), aufmassprofi_projects (p1 TEST_Projekt), aufmassprofi_reports (r1 with employee 07:00-16:20, rate 60), aufmassprofi_checklist_templates (t1 TEST_Vorlage), aufmassprofi_pro_unlocked='true'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seed localStorage, then reload. Navigate home → [data-testid=project-card-p1] so that index.tsx sets the Pro Features; deep-linking skips this. Use real mouse clicks; force clicks on Text do not always fire onPress. Sketch toolbar: set scrollLeft=500 on the toolbar scroller, then Rectangle is at (280,89) and Pen at (164,89). Drawing works by mouse drag on the canvas, and 'Elemente: N' shows the count. Line tool drag did not add an element (unverified mechanism). Leave dialogs are window.confirm; use an async page.on('dialog') handler. Photo upload: photos/new → mouse click (288,150) opens a file chooser → 'Foto speichern'.
rca_of_issue: The 'Maximum update depth' loop is fixed: repeat() is used instead of re-dispatching. Remaining web-only failures come from react-native-web 0.21.4 Alert.alert being an empty static method (node_modules/react-native-web/dist/exports/Alert/index.js:11), so button callbacks never run.
